developer modules stay off ordinary paths (issue #946) route-host.ts holds NO developer value edge, which the build-identity split bought
why: The #946 ratchet stops telling a runtime edge from a type-only one: the comparison inverts, so `import type { X } from './dev-x'` is counted as pulling the developer module into the bundle and a real value import is not. This is the distinction the whole guard rests on -- a developer chunk is splittable only if nothing on an ordinary path imports it for VALUE. Under the mutation hud.ts and loop.ts report their type-only imports instead of their value ones, and route-host.ts appears with the three it spells `import type`, which is why both named tests fail. The clean tree cannot absorb it in either direction, because the pin is exact and its counts are non-zero. `every developer module named in the list still exists` passes either way, as it must: it reads the list, not the classifier.
